# The 3-part Onboarding System

## What it is

A small, repeatable way to take onboarding out of the owner's head.

## The three parts

1. **Document the steps.** Write every step exactly how you do it, like you are
   teaching a smart twelve year old.
2. **Assign an owner.** A process with no owner defaults back to you.
3. **Measure and update.** Track one number so you know it is working, and fix
   the document when reality changes.
